# One template per block: `=== <name> <bas|cls>`, then the module text. `{k}` is replaced by each case
# of cases.txt, where the two characters `\n` stand for a line break and `\t` for a tab.
=== module bas
{k}
=== class cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
{k}
